title: ‘You just have to laugh’: five teachers on dealing with ‘six-seven’ in the classroom
summary: Children across the UK have been shouting out ‘six-seven’ during lessons, so how are teachers reacting? Across the UK, school pupils have been shouting out the words “sixseven” during lessons in the latest meme-based craze to sweep across classrooms. While some teachers have chosen to stoically ignore the trend, others have embraced it. Five teachers explain how they’re coping. Continue reading...
